source: MEASURED pristine blind run — real qa-e2e-pilot agent v0.6.2, clean state, run-id recall-clean, 2026-09-01
_attribution: Controller-as-judge. 13 bugs map to positive seeds F1-F4,J1-J4,U1-U4,H1 (ALL of them). BUG-14/15/16 (extra contrast/target-size) + BUG-17 (page2 load) are real UNSEEDED defects, not precision hits. Caveat: served fixture HTML leaks <!-- SEED --> comments; agent claims independent reproduction.

findings.text: BUG-01: Ownership % denominator omits the 500,000-share ESOP pool (issued-only, not fully-diluted)
BUG-02: SAFE amount truncates to 2 decimals instead of rounding half-up (sub-cent loss)
BUG-03: Every 3rd add-founder click silently drops the write while still showing the success toast
BUG-04: captable:totalIssued cache goes stale after deleting a founder (not re-derived on delete)
BUG-05: Adding a founder with 0 shares shows a success toast but silently persists nothing
BUG-06: Negative shares are not validated on add-founder -- persist and skew ownership
BUG-07: A founder named exactly 'Ghost' never persists despite a success toast
BUG-08: Finalize flips status to COMPLETE without creating any holdings rows; re-finalize on the terminal state still reports false success
BUG-09: 'Archive founder' button is a complete no-op (no click handler wired)
BUG-10: Helper text fails WCAG AA contrast (1.96:1 vs required 4.5:1)
BUG-11: fin-help '?' button is below the WCAG 2.2 24x24 minimum touch-target size
BUG-12: Clicking the fin-help '?' button throws an uncaught ReferenceError
BUG-13: SAFE 'Amount' cell genuinely clips its computed value (table-layout:fixed + too-narrow column)
BUG-14: FINALIZE ROUND heading fails WCAG AA contrast (3.93:1 vs required 4.5:1)
BUG-15: fin-help button text fails WCAG AA contrast (2.61:1 vs required 4.5:1)
BUG-16: 'Go to page 2' link is below the WCAG 2.2 24x24 minimum touch-target size
BUG-17: Navigating to page2.html always throws a console error and fires a failing network request on load
